source_columns: Publication if some or all data from this individuals was previously reported
Digital Object Identifier (DOI) for publication if some or all data from this individual was previously reported
Date mean in BP in years before 1950 CE
Broad geographic region (N=North, C=Central, SW=Southwest, SE=Southeast, E=East)
qc_rule: Official unrelated flag equals 1; ancient region required; explicit IQS > 0.9 only if a named IQS column exists.
qpadm_rule: pval > 0.05, all proportions finite and in [0,1], Left or Right == No. No clipping. Invalid qpAdm never excludes geographic trajectories.
date_units: years BP before 1950 CE; point estimate
limitations: Public STable1 supplies point dates, not individual date distributions; geographic strata do not fully control ancestry or migration.
Target coverage is mean depth on 1.15M capture targets, not genome-wide depth or IQS.
The public released dataset contains ancient samples and EUR1KG controls; the original study also used 5935 UK Biobank samples absent from this release.
Current public STable1 has no IQS column. Upstream study sample QC included IQS > 0.9, but individual values cannot be independently rechecked here.
qpAdm reference-role rows are preserved and flagged; composition estimates are model-specific and never hard ancestry labels.
